target_load_source: review load of the simple sensitive-area policy on the 2024 development cohort (324/891)
theta_rule: deterministic soft-score threshold whose 2024 load is closest to the target (0.325; theta 2 gave 0.404)
tau_rule: model risk threshold whose estimated 2024 load is closest to the target (0.356), estimated on a seeded random sample of 150 of the 696 development PRs the model would read (seed 20260926)
invocation: claude -p --model sonnet --tools '' --setting-sources '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <fixed> --output-format json, from an empty temporary directory
what_was_known_when: Thresholds theta and tau were chosen on 2024 data only. Before the freeze commit, the 2025 labels had already been adjudicated (oracle/labels.json, 10:35) and the list of 2025 PRs the model would read had been computed from the deterministic signals (10:50); signals.py was last edited at 10:53 (a path-based persistence signal, chosen from 2024 misses). No 2025 policy decision and no 2025 model answer existed before the commit: the first 2025 model answer is timestamped 10:55:33, the 2025 scoring ran at 11:02. The rule author had read the titles of the 2025 labelled PRs before writing the rules.
check_against_overfitting_2025: On 2024 the deterministic policy passed 7 of 28 confirmed failures at 32.5% load (random routing: 18.9); the path list 8 of 28 at 36.4% (random: 17.8). On 2025 both fall to chance level, which is not what rules tuned on 2025 would do.
